mapper.select: select count(1) from documents where id=#{orderId} and type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and approval_status='APPROVED' and deleted='0'
select count(1) from invoice_identities where seller_tax_id=#{sellerTaxId} and invoice_number=#{invoiceNumber}
select s.tax_id from purchase_orders p join suppliers s on s.document_id=p.supplier_id where p.document_id=#{orderId}
select tax_id from company_profile order by id limit 1
select buyer_id from purchase_orders where document_id=#{orderId}

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{buyerId} and u.status='0' and r.status='0' and r.role_key='purchaser'

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_id<>#{submitterId} and u.user_id<>#{purchaseId} and u.status='0' and r.status='0' and r.role_key='finance'
select count(1) from document_attachments where document_id=#{documentId}
select count(1) from purchase_order_lines where order_id=#{orderId} and id=#{orderLineId} and is_current='1'
select id,order_id,unit,price_p6,rate_r4 from purchase_order_lines where id=#{orderLineId} and is_current='1'

select d.id document_id,d.creator_id,d.number,d.revision,d.approval_status,d.current_node,i.order_id,i.invoice_number,i.seller_tax_id from documents d join invoices i on i.document_id=d.id left join purchase_orders po on po.document_id=i.order_id where d.type='INVOICE' and d.deleted='0' and (d.creator_id=#{userId} or po.buyer_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances wi on wi.id=t.instance_id where wi.document_id=d.id and (t.assignee_id=#{userId} or t.acted_by=#{userId}))exists(select 1 from sys_user cu where cu.user_id=d.creator_id and cu.dept_id=#{deptId} and cu.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from sys_user bu where bu.user_id=po.buyer_id and bu.dept_id=#{deptId} and bu.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances wi on wi.id=t.instance_id join sys_user au on au.user_id=t.assignee_id where wi.document_id=d.id and au.dept_id=#{deptId} and au.del_flag='0'))and i.invoice_number like concat('%',#{invoiceNumber},'%')and d.approval_status=#{approvalStatus} order by d.update_time desc

select d.id document_id,d.creator_id,d.number,d.revision,d.current_version,d.approval_status,d.current_node,i.order_id,i.invoice_number,i.invoice_type,i.issue_date,i.seller_name,i.seller_tax_id,i.buyer_name,i.buyer_tax_id,i.amount_cents,i.tax_cents,i.total_cents,i.difference_note,i.manual_confirmed,i.confirmed_content_hash,i.confirmed_by,i.confirmed_at from documents d join invoices i on i.document_id=d.id where d.id=#{documentId} and d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and d.deleted='0'

select id,invoice_id,line_no,order_line_id,name,unit,quantity_q4,price_p6,rate_r4,amount_cents,tax_cents,total_cents from invoice_lines where invoice_id=#{invoiceId} and is_current='1' order by line_no

select rl.id receipt_line_id,rl.item_snapshot,rl.quantity_q4-coalesce((select sum(a.quantity_q4) from invoice_allocations a where a.receipt_line_id=rl.id and a.state in('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')),0) remaining_quantity from receipt_lines rl join receipts r on r.document_id=rl.receipt_id join documents d on d.id=r.document_id where rl.order_line_id=#{orderLineId} and d.deleted='0' and rl.quantity_q4>coalesce((select sum(a.quantity_q4) from invoice_allocations a where a.receipt_line_id=rl.id and a.state in('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')),0) order by r.confirmed_at,d.number,rl.id for update
mapper.update: update invoice_lines set is_current='0' where invoice_id=#{invoiceId} and is_current='1'

update invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id set i.order_id=#{orderId},i.invoice_type=#{invoiceType},i.issue_date=#{issueDate},i.seller_name=#{sellerName},i.seller_tax_id=#{sellerTaxId},i.buyer_name=#{buyerName},i.buyer_tax_id=#{buyerTaxId},i.amount_cents=#{amountCents},i.tax_cents=#{taxCents},i.total_cents=#{totalCents},i.difference_note=#{differenceNote},i.manual_confirmed='0',i.confirmed_content_hash=null,i.confirmed_by=null,i.confirmed_at=null,d.revision=d.revision+1,d.update_time=now() where i.document_id=#{documentId} and d.revision=#{revision} and d.approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and d.creator_id=#{creatorId} and d.deleted='0'

update documents set approval_status=#{approvalStatus},current_node=#{currentNode},current_version=#{currentVersion},revision=revision+1,update_time=now() where id=#{documentId} and approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and revision=#{revision}

update invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id set i.manual_confirmed='1',i.confirmed_content_hash=#{hash},i.confirmed_by=#{userId},i.confirmed_at=now(),d.revision=d.revision+1,d.update_time=now() where i.document_id=#{documentId} and d.revision=#{revision} and d.approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and d.creator_id=#{userId} and d.deleted='0'
mapper.insert: insert into version_attachments(version_id,file_id,name_snapshot,sha256) select #{versionId},f.id,f.original_name,f.sha256 from document_attachments a join attachment_files f on f.id=a.file_id where a.document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.select: select id,flow_type,version,supervisor_candidates,finance_candidates from workflow_configs where flow_type=#{flowType} order by version desc limit 1
